rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a period spent in a place.

example.english: Our stay in Taipei this time lasted five days.
example.traditional: 今次去台北逗留咗五日。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 heoi3 toi4 bak1 dau6 lau4 zo2 ng5 jat6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for living somewhere or staying there for a period.

example.english: We’ll stay at a hotel tonight.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 zyu6 zau2 dim3

rows.note: Use this when someone remains behind instead of leaving, rather than specifically describing where they live or lodge.

example.english: You go ahead; I’ll stay behind to finish up.
example.traditional: 你哋走先啦，我留低執手尾。
example.jyutping: nei5 dei6 zau2 sin1 laa1 ngo5 lau4 dai1 zap1 sau2 mei5

rows.note: Use this when something continues to have a particular quality, especially in instructions such as staying warm.

example.english: It’s cold, so remember to stay warm.
example.jyutping: tin1 hei3 dung3 gei3 dak1 bou2 ci4 tai2 wan1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a legal order postponing an execution or other punishment.

example.english: The court issued a stay, so the punishment does not have to be carried out for now.
example.traditional: 法院頒下暫緩執行令，刑罰暫時唔使執行。
example.jyutping: faat3 jyun2 baan1 haa6 zaam6 wun4 zap1 hang4 ling6 jing4 fat6 zaam6 si4 m4 sai2 zap1 hang4

rows.note: Use this when something holds someone or something back, delays progress, or obstructs movement.

example.english: Don’t stay in the way; move over.
example.jyutping: m4 hou2 zo2 zyu6 tiu4 lou6 haang4 hoi1 di1

rows.note: Use this for a stiffening strip or stay sewn into clothing, including a collar.

example.english: There is a stay in the collar of this shirt, so it will not flop down.
example.traditional: 呢件恤衫領口有條衫骨，唔會塌落嚟。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 seot1 saam1 ling5 hau2 jau5 tiu4 saam1 gwat1 m4 wui5 taap3 lok6 lai4
